proposal.reasoning_trace: upi:ybl has dropped to 32% success over 96 attempts against a 90% portfolio baseline, and no Razorpay downtime notice covers it. Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
